resolvedPriorFinding.previousIssue: An awaited final callback could finish after the 180-second inner suite budget and still produce a certifying PASS marker during the longer Docker attach window.
resolvedPriorFinding.resolution: The stage runner applies the remaining monotonic budget after each awaited stage, converting over-budget completion to UNKNOWN and stopping later stages. The suite uses performance.now(), checks admission before stage execution, and applies the deadline guard both before and after final marker serialization. Integer diagnostic elapsed values retain the versioned advisory frame schema.
resolvedPriorFinding.reviewerProbe: The original scaled actual-code reproduction used a 1 ms budget and a 30 ms awaited callback. The repaired implementation returned outcome=unknown, exitCode=null, deadlineExceeded=true, elapsedMs=31, remainingMs=-30. This is a control-flow proof, not a 180-second runtime measurement.
resolvedPriorFinding.regressionCoverage: tests/verification-runner.test.ts:209-227 advances a deterministic remaining budget during an awaited callback, asserts UNKNOWN and deadlineExceeded, confirms the next stage does not run, and checks final marker-boundary conversion.
